title: HF3516 (2017-2018 Regular): Minimum age to possess a semiautomatic military-style assault weapon raised, definition of semiautomatic military-style assault weapon expanded, and transfer of a semiautomatic military-style assault weapon to underage persons criminalized.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/90/2018/0/HF/3516/versions/0/)
provenance.note: As-filed text, undated in the file (2018 session). Section 4 also strikes some old under-18 pistol wording and re-sorts the age exceptions. Sections 2 and 3 add definitions of detachable and fixed magazines. [Session A, 2026-11-19: quote line reformatted for the quote check (label, or "..." between separate clauses); words unchanged.]

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.712, subd. 7): (2) semiautomatic pistol, or any semiautomatic, centerfire, or rimfire rifle with a fixed magazine, that has the capacity to accept more than seven rounds of ammunition;
Section 4 (Minn. Stat. 624.713, subd. 1): (1) a person under the age of 21 years except that: ... (iv) a person under the age of 21 years may carry or possess a semiautomatic military-style assault weapon:
Section 5 (Minn. Stat. 624.7132, subd. 15): (1) transfers a pistol to a person under the age of 18 or a semiautomatic military-style assault weapon to a person under the age of 21, in violation of subdivisions 1 to 13; or
Section 6 (Minn. Stat. 624.7141, subd. 1): (4) is under the age of 21 years and the firearm transferred is a semiautomatic military-style assault weapon
